**Finding: MISSING** (severity medium, confidence 0.86)

The Agreement contains no exit machinery at all. Section 4 ("Term; Termination; Termination Payment") covers only the one-year auto-renewing term, the 90-day termination notice and the Termination Payment formula — it says nothing about what happens to our data when the relationship ends. Confirmed by targeted searches:

- "data" appears only in Section 8.1's definition of Confidential Information (a non-disclosure obligation on HDI, with no return-or-destroy step);
- no hits for transition, migration, wind-down, export or deletion;
- Section 10.7 (Survival) preserves Sections 6.3, 7, 9 and 10 but adds no exit obligations.

This matters materially here because HDI is the host and holds our Content, user information and customer data. With no clause at all, we sit below even the fallback (90 days' assistance plus 30-day export) and arguably in walk-away territory, since nothing obliges HDI to hand anything back.

**Redline (validated, ok:true):** new Section 4.3 inserted after p0029, at the preferred position — up to six (6) months' transition assistance at HDI's then-current rates, return of all Content, user information and customer data in a commonly used machine-readable format within thirty (30) days of the Termination Date, then deletion with written certification.

Negotiation note: the assistance period is the softer element — we can drop to 90 days if HDI pushes back, but the 30-day machine-readable return and the deletion certificate should be held.
